gaps: High-budget cinematic documentaries on tribal rebellions (Santhal Hul, Kol Ulgulan) treated as major mainstream historical milestones.
Uncensored biographical deep-dives into powerful non-monarchic female rebels and Mughal court matriarchs.
Rigorous archaeological and environmental collapse explanations for ancient Indian urban centers beyond popular myths.
saturated: Foreign or European historical mysteries (e.g., Princes in the Tower, Ancient China, foreign primitives) which consistently tank (vsNormal 0.08 to 0.17).
Generic medieval Rajput vs invader battle retellings without a specific untold hook (e.g., standard Prithviraj Chauhan Tarain recaps down at 0.22 vsNormal).
Speculative prehistoric human-vs-beast survival stories lacking Indian cultural resonance.
